title: Spyglass: Now Available to Everyone
summary: Get ready to unlock new perspectives as Spyglass officially moves out of beta and becomes available for all users.

title: Complete Control Over Your Files in the Editor
summary: Gain complete control over your files in the editor, enabling you to easily upload new media, manage existing attachments, and choose between a minimal or expanded view for perfect presentation.

title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap
summary: We're excited to launch our new public roadmap, providing a transparent view into our completed features, upcoming developments, and future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: We've upgraded our checkboxes to provide a smoother, more responsive experience, making them bigger, easier to drag, and perfectly aligned with our modern design.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've made real-time collaboration smoother and more intuitive, making it easier than ever to work together seamlessly.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: We've made it significantly easier to find and view all the items shared with you, boosting collaboration and knowledge sharing across your network.

title: Go Global with Multilingual Support
summary: Prepare for a truly global experience as Noeko introduces robust support for a wide array of international languages, making it accessible to everyone, everywhere.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: We are making Noeko's entire codebase publicly available, empowering our community with greater control, transparency, and direct involvement in shaping the future of the project.

title: Supercharge Your Constellation View
summary: Explore your knowledge base like never before with powerful new filtering options by tags and time, and easily visualize shared content and connections with your network, transforming your constellation view into a dynamic workflow hub.

title: Advanced Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Discover relevant information faster with enhanced filtering and sorting options, plus the ability to save your refined searches as personalized collections for easy access.

title: Dynamic Note Views
summary: Experience a more intuitive and interactive way to organize your thoughts with flexible note displays, allowing you to structure information exactly how you think.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: Our next major release empowers you to host Noeko on your own infrastructure and unlock premium features through new flexible plans designed for all users.

title: Stunning New Themes & Visual Upgrades
summary: Prepare for a visual transformation with beautifully refined existing themes and an exciting collection of vibrant new options to personalize your experience.

title: Personalized Time-of-Day Welcome
summary: We're enhancing our greetings to perfectly align with the time of day, ensuring a warm and accurate welcome every time you log in.

title: Direct Actions for Tagged Content
summary: Perform quick actions like unapplying tags and more directly on items within any tag view, making content organization faster and more intuitive.

title: Expand Your Knowledge Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring all your valuable insights together by integrating a wider array of content sources, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, into your unified workspace.
